name: uthai-thani-ai-travel-assistant
description: AI แนะนำสถานที่ท่องเที่ยวจังหวัดอุทัยธานี

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,WEB "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.dev:demo: concurrently -k -n API,WEB "npm run dev:demo -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/api && npm run lint -w apps/web
